My car got broken into on 8/2. I was out of town so my mom helped to arranged for it to be towed to the shop. She already paid for the towing service which was $217, and Steven claimed $497 and got the check from my insurance.

There was no other damages besides the broken windows. Weeks later, Steven told me that there are some scratches (which were not there when I dropped off the car key). I think these were caused by someone pressing the broken glass to smear them on the car body. He filed for a total $6k+ claim including products and services he quietly added to the estimation for repairing/replacing the body and parts that he vandalized.

I’ve reported this to the national and state bureaus for insurance fraud, and the CA bureau of auto repair along with my insurance’s SIU.

I hope he’s not going to secretly damage my car further because I will have to take legal actions before any bureaus did.
